entities.summary: Phillip Boa (b. 1963-01-18, Dortmund) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Dortmund and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
